fi-fundulopanchax-gardneri.title: Gardner's Killifish
fi-fundulopanchax-gardneri.summary: The steel-blue killifish, Fundulopanchax gardneri, is native to the Cross River system in Nigeria and Cameroon and the Benue River drainage. Also known as Gardner's killi or blue lyretail, the common…
rows: Carnivore / micropredator. Primarily a micropredator feeding on small aquatic crustaceans, worms, insect larvae and other zooplankton although algae and other plant material may also be taken.
Native to the Cross River system in southeastern Nigeria and western Cameroon plus the Benue River drainage in central Nigeria.
notes: The set-up need not be too complicated but be sure to cover the aquarium well since this species is a prodigious jumper.
Provide plenty of cover in the form of aquatic plants, wool mops, etc., and if using filtration air-powered, sponge-type units are best as these will not harm eggs or fry.

fi-oryzias-latipes.title: Oryzias latipes
fi-oryzias-latipes.summary: The medaka, Oryzias latipes, is a ricefish from Japan, Korea, Taiwan, eastern China, Laos and Vietnam. Long used as a model organism in genomic and experimental biology, it was the first vertebrate…
rows: Carnivore / micropredator. A micropredator feeding on small insects, worms, crustaceans and other zooplankton in nature.
Described from 'Japan' and current understanding considers it restricted to an area corresponding, more or less, to the boundaries of the East and South China seas and southern Sea of Japan.
notes: Best maintained in a heavily planted set-up, ideally with a dark substrate, patches of dense vegetation, and some open areas.
Other décor can consist of twisted roots and pieces of bogwood, while surface vegetation is also appreciated by the fish.
